speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you tell me your age and whether the breast mass you found is painful or painless?

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old woman. The patient noticed a mass in her left breast 4 weeks ago, which has rapidly increased in size. She denies any recent trauma or infections. No history of similar complaints in the past.

speaker: Doctor
text: Does the overlying skin show any changes such as redness, swelling, or a "peau d'orange" appearance, and have you noticed any nipple discharge or retraction? I will also request a diagnostic mammogram and ultrasound to evaluate the mass's characteristics. REQUEST TEST: Diagnostic_Mammogram

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Smooth polylobulated mass in the left breast.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Presence of a left breast mass. I also have Rapid increase in size of the mass, No skin or nipple changes, No pain associated with the mass. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the rapid growth and lack of skin changes, I need to rule out inflammatory processes or specific benign conditions like a phyllodes tumor. REQUEST TEST: Core_Needle_Biopsy

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Image shows leaf-like structures with stromal cellular overgrowth.

speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy results showing leaf-like structures with stromal cellular overgrowth are classic for a phyllodes tumor. DIAGNOSIS READY: Phyllodes tumor
